atoms.b: The perimeter is the ((++distance --height)) around a shape.
You can work out the perimeter by adding up the lengths of each ((++side --corner)) of the shape.
For example, the perimeter of this rectangle is <mat>10+10+5+<gap>++5 8</gap></mat>.
That means that the total perimeter of this rectangle is <mat><gap>++30 40</gap></mat>.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='1ms'/>That means that the total perimeter of this rectangle is 30.
